$comment: Confessions of deliberately removed CI steps. Read by packages/scripts-ts/src/check-ci-drift.ts. Required whenever a reconciled step vanishes from a workflow — the ratchet refuses to regenerate reason-guard-ref.json without this. See docs/guides/local-ci-gate.md.

steps.reason: Replaced by the sharded 'Run API test suite (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/4)' step as part of issue #1947. The single-runner `just test-api` step took ~14m41 and was 96% of the job; it now runs as a 4-way matrix where each shard provisions its own Testcontainers Postgres and runs a deterministic subset of the suite (partitioned by SHA-1 hash of the FQN). The full suite is still exercised by `just test-api` in `just ci`, which is strictly stronger than any one shard.
